summary: Nez Perce National Forest lookout: the 1932 L-4 cab blew away in 1967, the 1968 R-6 cab has lost its roof, and it is hike-in and emergency-only.

facts.design: R-6 cab on a 10-foot concrete base
facts.status_note: Roof blew off in the winter of 2020 to 2021; the register lists the cab as available for emergencies.

access.note: Listed as hike-in with emergency status; no public visiting described in the sources.

visit.trail_note: Hike-in per the Idaho lookout list; no trail distance given in these sources.

notes_for_editor: Height: the record's height_m 3.0 has no source. 10 feet is the concrete base height (about 3.05 m), so the record may be using the base; omitted. Base material conflicts: concrete in the register, firelookout.com and the Idaho list (which says 10′ concrete base); cinder block in the Forest Lookouts page. Current condition is unknown beyond the roof loss reported by firelookout.com; no later visit report found. The access level 'restricted' is my reading of 'available for emergencies' and 'Hike-In Emergency Status'. Forest name: the register and Idaho list say Nez Perce National Forest, firelookout.com says Nez Perce/Wallowa Whitman. The 1968 vs 1968–1969 construction dates differ slightly between the register and the Idaho list. The Idaho list's known-staff entries run from 1932–1933 to 1978–1980 with gaps, so 1932–1933 is not the only staffing record.
